$comment: WiseOwl COBOL (the `cobol` command; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §5). `cobol` is the command on PATH (the
dotnet tool); point it at a build with `run.py --compiler wiseowl --set cobol=<path>`. A compiled program is a
.NET assembly run with `dotnet`. The warning mechanism ISO 4.2.2 requires is the ordinary compile: WiseOwl
reports every syntax-rule and general-format violation it detects, and --flag-extensions adds the 4.2.10
warning for a nonstandard extension. A diagnostic reads `<file>(<line>,<column>): <severity> COBOLNET<n>: ...`.
An ASSIGN name is a file of the working directory. Crash codes: 0xE0434352 (an unhandled .NET exception on
Windows), 0xC0000005 (access violation) and 0xC00000FD (stack overflow); on Linux a crash is a signal.
A program's default USER and SYSTEM locales are its environment's (docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-118), so the
adapter pins both to the root locale, as WiseOwl's own runner does (CutRunner.LocalePin): a host's regional
